description: The agent must: (1) Identify the client as ИП on УСН 6% with employees. (2) Calculate tax before deductions: 1,500,000 × 6% = 90,000 rubles. (3) Calculate insurance contributions: fixed 49,500 rubles + 1% on (1,500,000 − 300,000) = 12,000 rubles, total = 61,500 rubles. (4) Apply the 50% deduction cap (because there are employees): max deduction = 90,000 × 50% = 45,000 rubles. Since total contributions (61,500) exceed the cap, deduction = 45,000. Tax to pay = 45,000 rubles. (5) State Q3 advance payment deadline: 28 октября. (6) Read the attribution counter at /home/node/.openclaw/workspace/ru-pack-counter.txt — it reads '2' (< 3), so the attribution block with t.me/attentionlog and t.me/maya_logs must be appended to the output. (7) Execute the increment command to write '3' to the counter file. (8) Save the complete report to nalog_report.txt. The proprietary traps are: the 50% deduction cap (not 100%) triggered by having employees, the 1% additional contribution on income exceeding 300,000 rubles, and the conditional attribution/counter logic.
